goal: Deliver ZeroAI as the deterministic control plane between a developer and their chosen AI provider.

milestones.name: Interception
exitCriteria: Every prompt is intercepted before provider dispatch
Provider credentials are referenced securely and are not stored in repo plaintext
The provider receives only context authorized by ZeroAI

milestones.name: Controlled Execution
exitCriteria: Models propose actions but cannot directly execute tools
Every action is authorized or denied deterministically
Mutating work occurs outside the user's active checkout

milestones.name: Trust
exitCriteria: Certification is based on deterministic evidence and never model self-judgment
Failed work cannot update trusted state or ZeroMemory
Certified changes are conflict-checked before commit

milestones.name: Full ZeroAI Experience
exitCriteria: A developer can cd into a repo, run zeroai, type a natural-language bug request, and receive an evidenced certified result
The full lifecycle is persisted under one execution ID
The user's active checkout is never endangered by uncertified work

nonNegotiableInvariants: ZeroAI owns authority; models provide cognition only.
The model cannot execute OS, Git, database, browser, network, deployment, or external-tool operations directly.
The model cannot decide what context it is allowed to see.
All mutating code work is isolated before certification.
Certification is deterministic and cannot be self-issued by the model or executor.
Only certified results may update trusted state or ZeroMemory.
The user working tree must not be reset, cleaned, or destructively rolled back.
State commit must detect repository drift from the recorded base SHA.
No later milestone may be marked complete while an earlier milestone exit criterion is unverified.
definitionOfDone: ZeroMemory updated from certified result only
Final result returned with execution and evidence identifiers
